rules: UniHack is a 30-day journey for students nationwide in Vietnam: opening event November 2 at Vietnam National University HCMC, final demo day November 30 at Ton Duc Thang University.
Final submission is listed for November 24 in the agenda; the Builder Hub closes submissions on November 25, 2026 at 05:59 AM Bangkok time.
After the online qualifying round, 10 teams are selected as finalists (November 27) and pitch, demo and take Q&A at the Final Demo Day.
Submit through the Avalanche Builder Hub: add your team members and upload your GitHub repo, presentation slides and any other supporting files.
Projects are judged on value proposition, technical complexity and usage of Avalanche technologies.
Prizes: $3,000 for the 10 finalist teams; $500 for students through the Builder Pass minigame (50 winners announced at Demo Day). No per-team split is stated.
